steps.en: Install the metapackage with the routers extra — without it there is no obb.equity
steps.zh: 安装元包并带上 routers 可选依赖，不带就没有 obb.equity

steps.en: Builds the obb interface from the installed provider and router extensions
steps.zh: 按已安装的数据源扩展和路由扩展生成 obb 接口

steps.en: Routes to a provider (keyless CBOE for US equity history) and returns a validated OBBject
steps.zh: 路由到数据源（美股历史走免 Key 的 CBOE），返回校验过的 OBBject

steps.en: Serve the same commands to other consumers
steps.zh: 把同一套命令提供给其他使用方

steps.en: Exposes them as REST at 127.0.0.1:6900 plus widgets.json for Workspace, or as MCP tools
steps.zh: 提供成 REST（含 widgets.json）或 MCP 工具

value.en: One integration per source, consumed from Python, REST, Workspace and agents — the price is a heavy install and providers dropped between majors
value.zh: 每个数据源只对接一次，Python、REST、Workspace 和智能体都能用——代价是安装很重，大版本之间会删数据源

sources: https://github.com/openbq-org/OpenBB README.md (pip install openbb; obb.equity.price.historical("AAPL"); openbb-api at 127.0.0.1:6900; Workspace 'Connect backend')
openbb_platform/pyproject.toml (openbb 5.0.0 dependencies; router extensions only in the `routers` extra)

local run 2026-10-09: openbb==5.0.0 without [routers] -> AttributeError: 'App' object has no attribute 'equity'; with [routers] -> provider cboe, AAPL daily bars; openbb-api served /widgets.json (971 widgets) and /api/v1/equity/price/historical
openbb_platform/extensions/mcp_server/README.md (openbb-mcp, uvx --from openbb-mcp-server --with openbb openbb-mcp; tool discovery)
release openbb-v5.0.0 notes (16 providers removed, AGPL-3.0-only -> Apache-2.0 in #7677)
